title: Pratiyogita Darpan
subtitle: Monthly current affairs arranged for recall, with practice questions
author: Upkar Prakashan

description: A monthly magazine of current affairs with facts arranged for recall, plus practice questions at the end of each issue.
bestFor: Candidates who want current affairs in a form they can revise rather than re-read.
